user_feedback: Remove the individual paper label and fiber collar. Print only essential information directly on a transparent food-contact vessel so the yogurt and ingredient trace remain the primary visual identity.
causal_rule: food reveals; direct print records; foil proves first opening; tools and hands prove process; paper appears only when it performs an outer transport job

architecture.name: edible evidence
architecture.job: Actual yogurt density, ingredient ribbon, fleck, thread, marble or oil interface creates the SKU color and product recognition.

architecture.name: transparent primary vessel
architecture.job: A validated food-contact vessel reveals the food, carries filling and sealing loads, and keeps one low-wide 150 g family silhouette.

architecture.name: direct print
architecture.job: One restrained dark factual-ink system records MORA, recipe, category, net weight and required information without a paper label, sleeve, collar or simulated label panel.

architecture.name: peelable foil
architecture.job: A flat full-perimeter foil and one asymmetrical tab prove sealing and first opening.

architecture.name: outer multipack only
architecture.job: Paper or molded fiber may restrain multiple sealed cups in transport but never wraps an individual cup or claims insulation, freshness or sustainability from appearance.

print_zones.front: MORA / recipe name / Infused Greek Yogurt / 150 g, centered on the authoritative front face with no opaque background patch
print_zones.side_or_rear: compact factual and regulatory information subject to market, substrate, legibility and food-label review
print_zones.bottom_or_rim: lot, date and variable traceability code after real production-line readability testing
print_zones.foil: seal and opening surface; no decorative paper simulation and no claim beyond verified seal behavior

fixed_invariants: no paper label, paper sleeve, paper collar, kraft band, sticker, opaque label-shaped field or wrap on an individual cup
actual food is the first and largest color field
one transparent low-wide 150 g vessel family with minimal dark direct print
one flat peelable foil with one readable opening tab
no decorative SKU color bands, global accent color or artificially tinted yogurt
no fragrance bottle, cosmetic jar, apothecary, pharmacy grid or Le Labo trade dress
production_boundaries: transparent-vessel material, oxygen and moisture barrier, light exposure, migration, seal integrity, cold-chain and shelf life require physical validation
direct-print ink system requires food-packaging suitability, adhesion, rub, condensation, abrasion, registration and legibility tests
black direct print is a directional baseline; contrast must be verified against every approved food state without adding a decorative opaque label panel
recyclable, recycled, compostable, plastic-free, freshness, leak-proof and small-batch claims remain prohibited without evidence
the generated package images are directional visualization, not a released production specification
stage_boundary: Revise Stage 2 only; Stage 3 remains locked until user approval.
